summary: Form 6-K filed by OKYO Pharma Ltd on July 23, 2026, announces an open-market purchase of 15,000 ordinary shares by CEO Robert J. Dempsey at $1.54/share on NASDAQ. This is a routine disclosure of an insider transaction, not a special situation. No corporate event, change of control, tender offer, restructuring, or strategic review is involved. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16. No deal terms exist. What to watch: standard insider buying signal but no event driving risk-arb or special-situations analysis.
